control_failures.control_label: atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work
authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of TX-3001 during a planned shutdown

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HOT_WORK_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work on TX-3001 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on TX-3001 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant. TX-3001 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 18 June 2021 an incident occurred on TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
